notes.title: We're hearing voices..
notes.content:
Lots of them ! We've received player feedback on the consistency of some recorded voice lines - and totally agree. So we've spent the last few days working on it, and have just pushed an update with all lines being a whole lot more consistent. 

We're not stopping here though. Always looking to improve and update as we go.

Any and all feedback is always welcome direct to contact@atrifleodd.com. Also visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/553050/discussions/0/135511913385757640/]Feedback/Bug/Help discussion topic[/url] for up to date information, or to see what we're currently working on. 

Thanks,
[url=atrifleodd.com]A Trifle Odd[/url]
